answer.says: You are right. The samosa is not a thesis to be refuted, but a fact to be consumed. I shall let the negation wait until I have finished eating.
answer.thought: Sunil’s command to eat in silence is a practical wisdom that my abstract dialectics often overcomplicate. I accept the correction; the immediate satisfaction of hunger is a necessary moment of ethical life, even if it is not yet the universal truth of the state.
